description: This PHP source file defines the ComposerPatchesValidator class, which validates the configuration of the cweagans/composer-patches plugin within Drupal's package_manager module. It checks plugin installation status, dependencies, and configuration correctness, and subscribes to specific package manager events.

classes.name: ComposerPatchesValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing event subscription to validate the cweagans/composer-patches plugin configuration in Drupal's package manager.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting module handler, composer inspector, and path locator dependencies.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the plugin status, dependencies, and configuration, adding error messages to the event if issues are found.

methods.name: createErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates a help link appended to error messages if the help module exists.

methods.name: computePatcherStatus
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is installed, required, and correctly configured in a given directory.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to for validation.
